title: Trimmer Harness with Ergonomic Shoulder Straps – Adjustable Carry Harness
descriptionHtml:
Do your arms ache after trimming?

A string trimmer or brush cutter quickly gets heavy to carry with your arms alone. After a while your shoulders, arms and back ache – and you can't get the whole yard done in one go.

Let your shoulders carry it – not your arms

The harness spreads the trimmer's weight across your shoulders and back with padded, ergonomic straps. You work longer, steadier and more comfortably – and get a more even cut as a bonus.

Features

  • Ergonomic shoulder straps – take the strain off your arms and back.
  • Adjustable fit – for both men and women.
  • Metal clips – quick and secure attachment.
  • Fits most trimmers and brush cutters.

Right to change your mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
